name: web-pastel-3d-microscope-and-dropper-render
title: Soft 3D lab microscope, petri dish and dropper bottle in sage and cream
whatItIs: A matte clay-style render of a microscope on an arm stand beside a petri dish, beaker and dropper bottle with pale green liquid, on a soft gradient from white to lime.
whatItMeans: Clean, gentle science; pastel materials make a lab feel friendly rather than clinical.
techniques: Render technical equipment in soft matte pastels.
Limit colours to cream, sage and one lime accent.
Use glass with tinted liquid for delicate contrast.
Light softly with a gradient backdrop.

vocabulary.definition: A 3D style with matte, soft-looking materials.
Transparent material with a coloured liquid inside.
A key image used at the top of a page.
